title: Umbrella with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- canopy sections -->
  <path d='M10 54 Q30 16 50 16 Q70 16 90 54 Z' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <!-- canopy scallops lighter -->
  <path d='M10 54 Q20 42 30 54 Q40 42 50 54 Q60 42 70 54 Q80 42 90 54 Q70 62 50 62 Q30 62 10 54 Z' fill='#ff9aae'/>
  <!-- scallop edge highlights -->
  <path d='M10 54 Q20 44 30 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0e8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M30 54 Q40 44 50 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0e8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M50 54 Q60 44 70 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0e8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M70 54 Q80 44 90 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0e8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- canopy ribs -->
  <path d='M50 16 L50 60' stroke='#ffd0dc' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M50 16 Q30 30 20 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0dc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M50 16 Q70 30 80 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0dc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- top knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- handle shaft -->
  <rect x='47' y='58' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#ffcf9e'/>
  <!-- hook handle -->
  <path d='M50 88 Q50 96 42 96 Q36 96 36 90' fill='none' stroke='#ffcf9e' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smiling face on canopy -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a1f4a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a1f4a'/>
  <!-- cheek blushes -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ffd23f' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ffd23f' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 45 Q50 54 60 45' fill='none' stroke='#3a1f4a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little tongue -->
  <path d='M46 49 Q50 53 54 49' fill='#ff9aae' stroke='none'/>
</svg>
